name: Notion Look-alike Importer
description: Back up a Notion workspace via the Notion API without losing data (raw JSON of every page, block and database, all files downloaded, verification report, safe re-sync) and keep its look: covers, icons, colored callouts, toggles, columns, all database views (table/board/gallery/list/calendar/chart) as Obsidian Bases with Notion-style view tabs, Notion formulas and rollups as live Bases formulas, and page icons in links, file list, tabs and Bases cells.
author: Destrudos6
